text:
Priya: Heads-up: I'm about to merge a docs change that standardizes examples on the compact envelope (less noise). Please shout if anyone's consumer-facing examples rely on the old long envelope.
Noah: Good call. Can we include two tiny SDK examples for parse-fallbacks (Python + TS) and a migration checklist? Customers always ask for step-by-step. :+1:
Priya: Yep. Adding `sdk_snippets/parse_fallback_py.md` and `sdk_snippets/parse_fallback_ts.md`. Also adding a short migration checklist under /examples/migration.md. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2278 (WIP).
ci-bot: PR opened by Priya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2278  status: draft.
Jade: Quick note from QA: found a stale link in `invoke-best-practices.md` pointing to `/examples/full-envelope`. That 404s. I'll paste grep results in the PR thread.
Priya: Thanks. I'll add redirect pages and update the link to `/examples/legacy/full-envelope` so we keep one canonical legacy example.
Noah: For the TS snippet, avoid `any` — use `unknown` and then narrow after runtime validation. Also include a snippet showing calling `function_call` when a tool returns `null`.
Priya: Added a "null-tool-output" example and a unit test vector showing expected fallback behavior.
Omar: Can we include a small `jq` runnable example that shows how to extract the compact envelope fields? Some infra folks like cli examples.
Priya: Good idea. Added `/examples/cli_extract.md` with a one-liner `jq` extraction and a note about safe parsing.
Jade: Reviewing PR now. Tiny nit: migration checklist item 2 says "update SDKs" but doesn't link to the SDK repo. Can you add a reference?
Priya: Done  added link to sdk-mono-repo and a quick patch suggestion for SDK authors. Also added a short changelog entry: "Docs: prefer compact envelope; legacy full-envelope preserved under examples/legacy"
Noah: One more ask: include a brief recommended testing checklist for teams (prompt + test vector + parse assertion). That saves back-and-forth.
Priya: Added "Team migration checklist" with example test vectors and an assertion snippet for pytest and a simple TS assert.
ci-bot: CI lint passed for docs PR #2278.
Jade: Approved. Looks good. Thanks for keeping the legacy example and the migration guide.
Priya: Merging in ~10m unless anything else pops up. Thanks all.
Noah: :thumbsup: Nice cleanup.
